title: Paul McCartney live: Ice Palace, Tampa | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Ice Palace in Tampa, Florida, USA, on 15 May 2002.

It was the 25th date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002. This show was seen by 16,128 fans.

The performances of ‘You Never Give Me Your Money’, ‘Carry That Weight’, and ‘Something’ from this show appear on the 2002 live albums Back In The US and Back In The World.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Ice Palace on 17 September 2005 for the US Tour, and 10 July 2017 for the One On One Tour.
